_comment: The approved strategy version is "active" (ADR 0011): every mutation path binds to it through scripts/strategy_version.py. Each entry pins the sha256 of memory/TRADING-STRATEGY.md for that declared version; the rulebook's marker must equal "active" and its hash must equal the active pin. A version bump changes the rulebook marker, adds a pin here, moves "active" and closes the previous entry with "until", all in one owner-reviewed commit; routines never edit the rulebook or this file.

v1.note: Frozen baseline. Closed when rule 14 entered unpinned on 2026-09-25 (c92afde).

v1.1.note: v1 engine parameters plus rule 14 (composition mandate). Marker in the rulebook reads v1.1. Closed by the v1.2 bump (map #93, #107).

v1.2.note: v1 engine parameters; rules 4 and 7 state the standing-stop contract (held fixed stop is permitted protection, drift is a recorded hold, renewal at the same or higher level is never a rule-7 violation) and the checklist band is 10% (ADR 0013, #104). Wording only, no parameter change.
